question.text: A trader holding a long USDINR futures position will receive which margin call if the market moves against them?

answer.text: The loss amount calculated through daily MTM settlement is debited from their margin account
They must pay the entire contract value upfront
No margin call — exchange absorbs the loss
A fixed penalty is charged regardless of the loss amount

explanation.text: The Logic: Open futures positions are marked to market at the daily settlement price. MTM loss obligations are collected from loss-making participants and paid to gainers, with the cash debit/credit happening on T+1. Members are alerted to bring additional capital when their margins require it. The Trap: MTM collects the actual loss amount based on the daily settlement price, not a fixed penalty, and it does not require paying the full contract value upfront. Gains are credited in the same cash debit/credit cycle. Note: Workbook references — p.51 (MTM collected from losers, paid to gainers), pp.166-167 (daily MTM at DSP, settled T+1), p.171 (members alerted to bring additional capital).
